Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter to target CHEMBL1972, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows.
